episodes.name: Level One: Your Quest Begins
episodes.overviewEn: An ordinary girl is pulled into the fantasy realm of Gemworld.

episodes.name: Level 2: Village of the Frogs
episodes.overviewEn: Princess Amethyst has her first battle in the village, but can she handle the heat?

episodes.name: Level Three: Random Encounter
episodes.overviewEn: A quick swim in the lake turns into a fierce underwater fight! Can Princess Amethyst make it out alive?

episodes.name: Level Four: The Turquoise Cave
episodes.overviewEn: Princess Amethyst runs into trouble in a spooky cave, but appearances can be deceiving.

episodes.name: Level Five: Battle in the Stormy Peaks
episodes.overviewEn: Frog Prince is in trouble! Can Princess Amethyst and her winged unicorn save him?

episodes.name: Level Six: The Final Boss
episodes.overviewEn: Princess Amethyst's winged unicorn, Max, has been taken from her and now she must fight her arch nemesis, Dark Opal, on her own! Does she have the strength to defeat him and restore peace to Gem World?

episodes.name: Level Seven: Welcome Home
episodes.overviewEn: Gem World is saved and now Princess Amethyst must decide if she wants to stay a Princess in her new kingdom, or return to Earth as Amy.
